items.author: Seth Walder
items.body_excerpt:
Eagles needed just a 13% chance of converting to justify going for it, so this was the only decision.

Value of being up 13 vs. 10 is very small and would have given Rams better field position than a 4th down failure, too. 

Correct call by Philly.
